root_cause: The component registry was an old generated snapshot and represented historical Make-backed PH Agent 01-16 entries as active after the canonical runtime authority retired the Make execution estate.
prevention_rule: A component registry may retain historical Make identities only as provenance. PH Agent 01-16 must resolve to runtime=make, status=legacy_retired_path, authority=NONE and production_execution_allowed=false while the canonical runtime authority classifies the Make estate as LEGACY_RETIRED_PATH. Registry source authority version/fingerprint must match the canonical contract.
